package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- shared/shared.go --
package shared

import "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"

type Store struct{ Kind string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewStore() *Store { return &Store{Kind: "primary"} }

//fabrik:provider name=archive
func NewArchiveStore() *Store { return &Store{Kind: "archive"} }

//fabrik:inject s name=archive
//fabrik:cli:command
func Boot(ctx cli.Context, s *Store) error { return nil }

//fabrik:cli:command
func Check(ctx cli.Context, s *Store) error { return nil }
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"

	"app/shared"
)

func run() int {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	sigc := make(chan os.Signal, 2)
	signal.Notify(sigc, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer signal.Stop(sigc)
	go func() {
		<-sigc
		cancel()
		<-sigc
		os.Exit(1)
	}()

	root := &cli.Command{
		Name: "app",
		Subcommands: []*cli.Command{
			{
				Name: "boot",
				Run: func(ctx cli.Context) (err error) {
					store, err := buildBoot(ctx)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					return shared.Boot(ctx, store)
				},
			},
			{
				Name: "check",
				Run: func(ctx cli.Context) (err error) {
					store, err := buildCheck(ctx)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					return shared.Check(ctx, store)
				},
			},
		},
	}
	return root.Exec(os.Args[1:], cli.WithSignalContext(ctx))
}

func buildBoot(ctx context.Context) (*shared.Store, error) {
	// Providers
	sharedStoreArchive := shared.NewArchiveStore()
	return sharedStoreArchive, nil
}

func buildCheck(ctx context.Context) (*shared.Store, error) {
	// Providers
	sharedStore := shared.NewStore()
	return sharedStore, nil
}
